sanity_gate: scripts/zeroshot_globaltrack.py on 8 TRAIN RGB sequences (exploratory): converted mSA > COCO-init control + 10; if it fails, A2 stops and the conversion is investigated (never tuned on VAL)

A2a_largescale.conversion_fidelity_reading: VAL within 1.0 pt of the paper in both modalities = conversion behaviourally faithful; otherwise the C1/C2 conventions (or another difference) matter for an un-fine-tuned model and the A2b rows carry that caveat

A2b_visible.schedule: 12 epochs, LR x0.1 at epochs 8 and 11 (PAPER-EXPLICIT visible), every other setting as Phase A IR (batch 2, LR 0.0025, 1,600 pairs/epoch, warm-up 500 iterations, grad clip 35, fp32), seed 0, final-epoch checkpoint (no selection)

rules.reproduced_val: |ours - paper| <= 1.0 mSA on VAL (the Phase A band)
rules.test_reading: descriptive vs the paper; the IR test surplus (+4-5 pt) is open, so a visible test surplus is reported as consistent / inconsistent with it
rules.dfsc_effect: DFSC - normal on VAL and TEST compared with the paper's +0.48 / +0.57 (one seed: screening only)

run_order: sanity gate -> A2a VAL IR + RGB -> A2b training normal, DFSC -> A2b VAL -> TEST passes (A2a IR, A2a RGB, A2b normal, A2b DFSC; one each) -> analysis; all steps run regardless of intermediate results except the sanity gate
test_usage: four new checkpoints/modalities, one TEST pass each, recorded in reports/test_evaluation_ledger.jsonl
estimated_gpu_hours: ~16 (2 x 12-epoch RGB trainings ~3 h each, 6 VAL/TEST tracking passes ~1.5-2.5 h each)
